acceptance_criteria.criterion: workspace-detail.js no longer contains a local makeBranchTrigger function.
workspace-detail.js imports buildRepoStatusCells, makeBranchTrigger, and updateRepoStatusCells from ../components/repo-status-cells.js.
The workspace-detail view renders identically to the pre-refactor version: same DOM structure, same CSS classes, same data-repo-id attributes.
Polling countdown and in-place badge/branch updates continue to work correctly.
Branch-quick-switch popover triggers correctly on non-STABLE branch cells.
The Browse button appears when webserverUrl is configured; Git GUI button always appears.
STABLE workspaces show plain-text branch names (no clickable triggers).

summary: Refactored workspace-detail.js to use shared repo-status-cells.js component. Removed the local makeBranchTrigger function and the duplicated branch/badge/actions cell logic from buildRepoStatusRow and updateStatusTable. Added import of { buildRepoStatusCells, makeBranchTrigger, updateRepoStatusCells } from ../components/repo-status-cells.js and removed the now-redundant createStatusBadge import. buildRepoStatusRow now builds only the name <td> locally and delegates the three shared cells to buildRepoStatusCells. updateStatusTable now iterates rows and delegates per-row updates to updateRepoStatusCells. All 752 backend tests and 38 frontend tests (repo-status-cells, workspace-detail.open-button, workspace-detail.vscode-button) pass.

comments.note: The JSDoc on buildRepoStatusRow still references 'the polling update can locate and replace badge contents in-place' — this is now handled by updateRepoStatusCells in repo-status-cells.js. The comment is not wrong but could be updated to say the shared component handles in-place updates, improving discoverability.

updateStatusTable in workspace-detail.js is now a thin loop wrapper around updateRepoStatusCells. It could be eliminated entirely and its two call sites (doPoll, doRefresh) changed to inline loops calling updateRepoStatusCells directly, removing the last local status-table helper. Deferred — it is still clear and has no duplication.

The frontend .test.mjs files are not included in the npm test script (which only runs compiled TypeScript tests). They must be run manually with node --test. Consider adding a separate npm script (e.g. test:gui) that discovers and runs all gui/**/*.test.mjs files so they are not accidentally skipped in CI.

summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified. 38 frontend tests pass (repo-status-cells.test.mjs, workspace-detail.open-button.test.mjs, workspace-detail.vscode-button.test.mjs). 752 backend tests pass. Static code inspection confirmed: no local makeBranchTrigger function in workspace-detail.js, createStatusBadge import removed, all three symbols imported from repo-status-cells.js, cleanup function correctly clears countdownInterval, isStable/onBranchCellClick/webserverUrl correctly threaded through buildStatusTableSection and updateStatusTable to the shared component.

comments.note: The frontend .test.mjs files must still be run manually with 'node --test' — they are not discovered by 'npm test'. The Developer's debt comment about adding a 'test:gui' npm script stands. No action required for this WP but worth tracking for CI completeness.

No regressions detected. webserverUrl is correctly threaded from the API config fetch all the way through buildStatusTableSection into buildRepoStatusCells. The Browse button only appears when webserverUrlConfig.webserverUrl is a non-empty string, matching the AC.

Edge-case: onBranchCellClick is defined after buildStatusTableSection is called (line 1050 vs line 848), but since it is referenced via closure inside polling callbacks (lines 969, 999), and the initial table build passes the function reference at render time, there is no hoisting issue — the function declaration is hoisted before the Promise.all .then() body executes.

comments.note: Fixed stale JSDoc on buildRepoStatusRow (workspace-detail.js, lines ~161-164). Old text said 'The row uses data-repo-id on the badge container so the polling update can locate and replace badge contents in-place' — inaccurate since data-repo-id is now set by buildRepoStatusCells and polling updates are performed by updateRepoStatusCells in repo-status-cells.js. Updated description to reflect delegation to the shared component, with cross-references to both functions.

updateStatusTable (lines 236-242) is a thin loop wrapper around updateRepoStatusCells. Decision to keep it (noted by Developer and QA) is sound — it hides iteration from call sites (doPoll, doRefresh) and keeps the calling code symmetric. No action required; deferred intentionally.

onBranchCellClick is declared at line 1050 but first passed to buildStatusTableSection at line 848. QA correctly noted this is safe due to function-declaration hoisting — the .then() callback runs after the synchronous parse of the module, so the function is already defined. No issue; leaving as-is.
